programme.desc: Jamie och Claire hjälper en slav rädda sin tvillingbror, men upptäcker snart att situationen är betydligt mer komplicerad än de först trodde.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Down The Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: När singlarna släpper loss på fest riskerar svartsjukan att sätta käppar i hjulet för ett par. Frustrationen stiger när huset inser att bara ett av de starka paren skulle kunna vara rätt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It Takes One To Know One
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: Några gäster kommer med råd och tips om hur man hittar den rätta. Sanningsbåset avslöjar den skiftande dynamiken i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Stricking Out
programme.desc: Äntligen kan Kamie bekräfta ett par vid Parceremonin. Ett favoritpar får veta sitt öde. Ett annat ångrar sin separation.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Kiss And Tell
programme.desc: Will får sota för att ha bevarat sitt förhållande med Courtney samtidigt som han letade den rätta. Huset visar upp dolda talanger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One
programme.desc: Efter veckors debatterande om hur de ska hitta den rätta samarbetar nu singlarna i ett riskabelt försök att hitta äkta kärlek.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Tio singeltjejer och tio singelkillar tillbringar en månad ihop och försöker hitta sin perfekta partner. Om de lyckas får de dela på det största priset i MTV:s historia - en miljon dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Temptation of Chris T
programme.desc: Chris T riskerar hela priset på en miljon dollar eftersom han inte kan släppa Shanley, och när Ryans dagböcker försvinner söker han tröst hos Kayla - som i sin tur söker tröst hos Wes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Real 'G'
programme.desc: Det blir alltmer spänt mellan Jacy och Simone medan de kämpar om Johns gunst. Det tänder till mellan Brittany och Adam när de får åka till boom-boom-rummet , och i utmaningen avslöjar tjejerna pinsamma gamla saker om sig själva.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: Utmaningen består i att killarnas ex avslöjar allt och sen tillbringar kvällen i huset. Brittany verkar inte fatta att Adam helt enkelt inte är intresserad. Coleysia och Ashleigh påbörjar egna romanser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Läget är spänt mellan John och Simone. Kayla blir intresserad av Wes igen, men hon håller ändå kvar vid Ryan. Gänget blir på glatt humör när de får skicka två par till sanningsbåset efter vattenfallstävlingen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alla försöker att klura ut vilket som är nästa perfekta par. Kayla avslöjas när hon spelar ut Ryan mot Wes, och Simone försöker att splittra Chris T och Shanley för gott. Ett besök i sanningsbåset vänder upp-och-ned på huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye
programme.sub-title: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Kaos råder i huset efter att Paige och Chris T visar sig vara ett par och de skickas på smekmånad. Shanley är uppriven för att hon och Chris T. skiljs åt. Och Kayla blir hysterisk när Ryan går iväg för att trösta Jessica.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla och Ryan grälar och hela huset vänder sig emot Kayla när hon avslöjar en känslig sak som kan hota Ambers förhållande med Ethan. En slipprig utmaning visar om vissa par klarar av att hänga ihop.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Hela gänget släpper loss och har kul på vita festen, men John måste ta itu med det faktum att Jacy börjar få känslor för Scali. En strandtävling tvingar paren att sanda ner sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Alla i huset försöker lista ut hur de ska ta tillvara på sina sista chanser att hitta den rätta och vinna en miljon dollar. Jacy tar itu med sina motstridiga känslor för Scali och John och alla i huset försöker nysta ut den sista kärlekstriangeln.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagarna i säsong ett återförenas för den största händelsen i Ethans och Ambers liv - en bebis! Upptäck vad som hänt deltagarna medan de tillbringar en vild helg ihop för att fira med en sanslös babyhippa på AYTO-vis.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: Tio perfekt ihopparade killar och tjejer blir chockade när de får veta att den här säsongen blir tuffare än de trodde med tillkomsten av en elfte tjej. Paris och Pratt smider planer för att slippa sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Läget blir spänt när både Layton och Shelby hamnar i kärlekstrianglar. Killarna gräver upp saker om tjejerna i en tävling som kan skicka den elfte tjejen till sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: När Shelby sätter stopp för sin kärlekstriangel leder det till tårar. John söker kontakt med Christina, men blockeras hela tiden av Brandon, som redan vet att de inte är ett par. Hela huset häpnar över att de har en oskuld i gänget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: Ett hångel på fyllan hotar att stjälpa ett av husets starkaste par. Anthony lägger an på Laytons förälskelse, Jenni. John lägger äntligen in en stöt på Christina. En chockerande parceremoni skakar om hela huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset är i chock efter den senaste parceremonin. Jenni tror att Layton är hennes match, men fruktar vreden från en förkrossad Jessica. Sanningsbåset riskerar att ge ännu mer hjärtesorg för ett av paren.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Det södra Lufttemplet
programme.desc: Aang är ivrig att få visa Sokka och Katara Lufttemplet där han växte upp. Men vid ankomsten, blir det uppenbart att templet inte alls är som Aang mindes det.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Krigarna i Kyoshi
programme.desc: Som en av Aangs små omvägar, är gänget på väg mot ön Kyoshi. Men de blir snart varse att stadsbefolkningen inte alls litar på främlingar; hur som helst, när Aang visar dem att han är Avataren blir dem behandlade som hedersgäster.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Kungen av Omashu
programme.desc: Aang tar med Katara och Sokka till en favoritplats dit han brukade gå när han var yngre, Jordrikets stad, Omashu. Men när de bryter mot lagen förs dem till kungen för att få sitt straff.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Fängslade
programme.desc: Ungarna kommer till en stad i Jordnationen som är ockuperad av Eldnationen. Men kommer Kataras försök att inspirera det förtryckta folket hjälpa dem eller skada dem.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Vintersolståndet, del 1: Andevärlden
programme.desc: Aang, Katara och Sokka anländer till en stad som terroriseras av en mystisk kraft från andevärlden. Aang vet inte hur han ska hjälpa de människorna, och upptäcker att han har mycket att lära sig om hur det är att vara Avataren.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Vintersolståndet, del 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: Under vintersolståndet måste Aang nå ett Eldnationstempel, medan han slingrar sig ifrån prins Zuko, kommendör Zhao och Eldsmännen som vaktar det.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Vattenbändningsrullen
programme.desc: Efter att Katara försökt lära Aang vattenbändning, vill hon desperat förbättra sin förmåga.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Jet
programme.desc: När de reser mot Nordpolen, blir gänget nästan fångade av Eldnationen.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Den stora uppdelningen
programme.desc: När Aang och vännerna kommer till randen av en stor ravin, ombeds dem att hjälpa två grupper av flyktingar över densamma.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Stormen
programme.desc: En kraftfull storm tvingar fram smärtfulla minnen från det förgångna - och utsätter alla nuvarande för fara.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Den blå anden
programme.desc: Efter att Sokka och Katara blivit sjuka på grund av stormen, hittar Aang ett botemedel och upptäcker att han behöver frusna grodor för att göra dem friska.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Spåkvinna
programme.desc: Aang, Katara och Sokka upptäcker en by med människor som alla är beroende av en spåkvinna i deras vardagsliv - men de är så beroende att dem är som blinda inför den ofrånkomliga faran dem svävar i.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Bato av Vattenfolket
programme.desc: Aang känner sig osäker när Katara och Sokka hittar något som påminner dem om sitt hem. För att Aang tror att hans vänner kanske lämnar honom, gömmer han ett viktigt meddelande vilket bara ställer till problem.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Avhopparen
programme.desc: Aang försöker hitta en Eldbändningsmästare som kan undervisa honom, medan Katara upptäcker att hon besitter en speciell kraft.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Det norra Lufttemplet
programme.desc: Efter att ha hört rykten om överlevande Luftbändare, reser ungarna till det norra Lufttemplet för att undersöka det. Det de hittar där kan uttalas katastrof för alla Eldnationens fiender.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Vattenbändningsmästaren
programme.desc: Ungarna kommer fram till det norra Lufttemplet, och Aang och Katara letar efter en vattenbändningsmästare, medan Sokka faller för en prinsessa. Under tiden planerar Zhao en attack, och Zuko måste kommapå ett sätt att fortsätta sin jakt på Avataren.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: De norra ordensmännen, del 1
programme.desc: Det norra Vattenfolket förbereder sig för en attack av amiral Zhaos Eldflotta. I stridens hetta, kämpar Aang för att försvara staden. Han undrar om det inte finns något bättre sätt att använda sin Avatarförmåga.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: De norra ordensmännen, del 2
programme.desc: Zhaos invasion bryter igenom det norra Vattenfolkets yttre försvarslinje, och han avslöjar en djävulsk plan.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Avatartillståndet
programme.desc: Aang och gänget träffar en general från Jordkungariket som vill använda Aangs 'Avatartillstånd' som ett vapen för att besegra Eldnationen. Men att hamna i 'Avatartillståndet' med vilja, är mycket svårare än Aang trott.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: De två älskandes grotta
programme.desc: På sin väg till Omashu, träffar ungarna en grupp nomader, som visar dem en genväg genom 'De två älskandes grotta.'

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Åter till Omashu
programme.desc: Ungarna återvänder till Omashu så att Aang kan lära sig Jordbändning av kung Bumi. Men när de kommer dit, blir de chockade över att staden nu är i Eldnationens händer. Trots faran, går Aang in i Omashu för att leta efter kung Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Träsket
programme.desc: När ungarna hamnar i ett mystiskt träsk, visar sig deras fruktan. Och Aang lär sig om att ha 'kontakt med Jorden' av en osannolik lärare.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Avatardagen
programme.desc: Aang måste reda ut en våg av anti-Avatarkänslor, och måste förlikas med något han gjort i det förflutna.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Den blinde banditen
programme.desc: I jakt efter en Jordbändningslärare åt Aang , går ungarna till en hemlig Jordbändningsturnering där dem stöter på Toph, en blind, men kraftfull Jordbändare.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Zuko själv
programme.desc: På resa utan Iroh nu, vandrar Zuko ensam in i en stad i Jordriket där han lär känna en pojke som bor där. Under tiden, jagas Zuko av minnen från sin egen ungdom.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Jakten
programme.desc: När ungarna obarmhärtigt jagas av en mystisk maskin, gör deras utmattning att de går varandra på nerverna.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Hårt arbete
programme.desc: När Aang kämpar med en sten medan han försöker lära sig Jordbändning, undrar han om hans problem ligger hos honom eller hos hans lärare. Under tiden hamnar Sokka i en knipa.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Biblioteket
programme.desc: En professor för ungarna till ett andligt bibliotek mitt ute i öknen, där Sokka hoppas upptäcka kraftfulla hemligheter att användas mot Eldnationen.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Öknen
programme.desc: Aang letar efter Appa, medan Katara kämpar för att alla ska hålla ihop, så de kan överleva i den väldiga öknen. Under tiden, söker Iroh och Zuko hjälp från en hemlig, gammal förening

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Ormpassagen
programme.desc: Gänget samlas kring kartan för att diskutera åt vilket håll dem ska gå - Ormpassagen verkar bli den genaste vägen.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Borren
programme.desc: Aang upptäcker ett hemligt supervapen, som Eldnationen riktar rätt mot Ba Sing Se och måste stoppa det innan det förstör den väldiga mur som skyddar staden från invasion.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Murarnas och hemligheternas stad
programme.desc: Aang och ungarna anländer äntligen till Ba Sing Se för att träffa Jordkungen, och upptäcker mystiska krafter i staden som gaddar ihop sig för att stoppa dem. Under tiden försöker Jet hitta bevis för att Zuko och Iroh tillhör Eldnationen.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Historierna om Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: En serie noveller, belyser olika karaktärer och deras individuella äventyr i staden. Historier om Katara och Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko och Momo.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: När Appa var försvunnen
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet går vi tillbaka i tiden till ett ögonblick när Appa stals, och får exakt reda på vad som hände och var han höll hus hela den tiden - och var han är nu.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Laogaisjön
programme.desc: Medan de letar efter Appa, stöter ungarna på Jet, men är oense om de kan lita på honom eller inte. Under tiden letar Zuko också efter Appa.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Jordkungen
programme.desc: Ungarna kämpar mot Dai Lin, Long Feng medan de försöker visa Jordkungen den stora konspiration som pågår i staden. Zuko skadas allvarligt och får feberaktiga drömmar när han genomlider en andlig kris.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Gurun
programme.desc: Aang börjar få kontroll över Avatartillståndet, tack vare Guru Pathik vid det östra Lufttemplet. Sokka återförenas med sin far.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Ödets vägskäl
programme.desc: När Aang får en vision om att Katara är i fara, skyndar Aang, Sokka och Toph tillbaks till Ba Sing Se för att rädda henne. De träffar Iroh som ber om deras hjälp att rädda Zuko som också blivit tillfångatagen.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Uppvaknandet
programme.desc: Efter att Aang råkat ut för flera skador i slutet av säsong 2, så vaknar han upp och hittar sig själv ombord på Eldnationens skepp. Samtidigt är Zuko på väg hem.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Pannbandet
programme.desc: Ett missförstånd gör att den utklädde Aang tas för en elev på Eldnationsskolan, vilket gör att han måste skriva in sig där. Förklädnaden förbättras av att han sätter ett pannband i håret.

programme.title: Avatar- Legenden om Aang: Den målade damen
programme.desc: När gänget kommer till en lidande fiskeby, så dyker det upp en mystisk ande som hjälper byborna.

programme.desc: När gänget kommer till en lidande fiskeby, så dyker det upp en mystisk ande som hjälper byborna.

programme.title: Hamilton
programme.desc: Vanki. Hamilton on jäänyt vangiksi eikä suostu paljastamaan, kenelle työskentelee. Säpon ja armeijan välit ovat pahasti tulehtuneet. Ruotsalaisessa trillerisarjassa tapaamme Jan Guilloun menestyskirjojen suositun hahmon, nuoren agentin Carl Hamiltonin. Hän palaa Ruotsiin USA:sta monivuotisen Navy SEAL -koulutuksen jälkeen. Samaan aikaan Tukholmaa järkyttää terrori-iskujen sarja. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Feed
programme.desc: Kauhuelokuva nuorista, jotka kutsutaan luksusleirintäalueelle erämaahan, missä vaanii jokin paha. Guldbaggenin yleisöpalkinnon voittaja.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: Katastrofi-toimintatrilleri, jossa maapalloon uhkaa iskeä komeetta. Atlantassa tapaamme insinööri John Garryn, joka yhdessä vaimonsa Allisonin ja poikansa Nathanin kanssa kamppailee paetakseen ja jäädäkseen eloon nähdessään tulevan tuhon laajuuden.

programme.title: Uutisreportteri Morgan Pålsson
programme.desc: Epäpätevä ruotsalaistoimittaja valokuvaajineen joutuu ainoana ulkomaalaistiiminä keskelle sotilasvallankaappausta pienessä afrikkalaisessa maassa.

programme.title: Eemeli ja possuressu
programme.desc: Eemeli tekee äitinsä mukaan enemmän metkuja kuin vuodessa on päiviä. Mutta kyllä hän ehtii välillä muutakin... Huutokaupassa Eemeli tekee erikoisia kauppoja. Mutta kaikkein ihmeellisin tapaus on se, kun Eemeli pelastaa pienen vastasyntyneen possun hengen. Eemeli ei ainoastaan pidä huolta pikku possuressusta, vaan opettaa sille myös temppuja! Possu oppii istumaan kauniisti, hyppäämään ilmaan ja muitakin hienoja konsteja! Kukaan Vaahteramäen asukkaista ei olisi voinut kuvitellakaan pienen possun pystyvän moiseen!

programme.title: Veljeni Leijonamieli
programme.desc: Kuolemansa jälkeen Kaarle ja Joonatan Leijona tapaavat lyhyen maallisen elämänsä jälkeen Nangijalan taianomaisessa maassa. Kirsikkalaakson idyllistä elämää kuitenkin uhkaa julma ritari Tengil, joka on ottanut vallan Ruusulaaksossa.

programme.title: Kopioitu Telsu.fi:stä
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrenin kirjoihin perustuva ruotsalainen lastensarja seitsemänvuotiaasta Marikki-tytöstä, jolla on suuri sydän. 1983

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Kaasuvuoto aiheuttaa ulkonaliikkumiskiellon. Jengi yrittää tappaa aikaa pelien avulla, mutta kaikki keskustelut johtavat riitaan. Kaaos vain laajenee. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Rut ja Daniel ovat uusi ”it-pari”, ja Fube haluaa hyödyntää tätä luomalla heistä Branded Media Content -sisältöä. Luvassa on kuitenkin haasteita. Samalla Cajsa oppii uusia ja vähemmän mukavia puolia tyttöystävästään Nadjasta. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Hasse haluaa valmistautua padelmessuihin, mutta saako hän Fabianin mukaan? Fabian on nimittäin rakastunut ja keskittyy nyt vain Lindaan. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Tobias saa korvauksen vankilaan unohtamisesta. Morraninkin pitää osallistua jakamalla mainoksia. Autolla se sujuisi, mutta kumpikaan ei osaa ajaa. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Morranilla on syntymäpäivä. Hän toivoo muuttumisleikkiä ja toiveillallista, kuten TV:ssä. Tobias järjestää molemmat ja laittaa koko homman verkkoon. programme.title: Fake Patient
programme.desc: Förnekelse. Albin yrittää elää tavalliseen tapaan ja onnistuu ison pääroolin koekuvauksissa. Hän pyytää Yvonnelta anteeksi ja jatkaa flirttailua Cissin kanssa. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Samaan aikaan Albin on aloittanut syrjähypyn agenttinsa Cissin kanssa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Ei omena kauas.... Klara saa tarpeekseen kaikkialle ilmestyvistä somevaikuttajista. Tomas huomaa kauhukseen, että alkaa muistuttaa isäänsä. Ludde kittaa energiajuomia. programme.title: Irralliset
programme.desc: Mathilda yrittää peittää salaisuutensa Johannekselta samalla kun Martha salaa toisen ison asian Sebastianilta. Emil on innoissaan treffeille lähdöstä. Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.desc: Ei omena kauas.... Klara saa tarpeekseen kaikkialle ilmestyvistä somevaikuttajista. Tomas huomaa kauhukseen, että alkaa muistuttaa isäänsä. Ludde kittaa energiajuomia. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Hotel Swan Helsinki
programme.desc: Murhatutkintaan tulee yllättävä käänne, jota seuraa pidätys. Kaiken tämän keskellä Hotel Swanissa järjestetään hääjuhlat. Maija tutustuu leukemiaa sairastavaan Sonja-tyttöön. Suomi 2020

programme.title: Kopioitu Telsu.fi:stä
programme.desc: Turmanluoti. Antin tutkijakollegan raaka murha saa Marian ymmärtämään, että murhan kohteena oli Antti. Ehtiikö Maria saada murhaajan kiinni ennen kuin murhaaja onnistuu kostossaan? 2020

programme.title: From
programme.desc: Fray. Hirvittävä löytö ravisuttaa koko kaupunkia kun Jade ja Tabitha painivat hämmentävän oivalluksensa kanssa. Matthewsin perhe on automatkalla jossain keskellä Yhdysvaltoja, kun he jäävät jumiin mystiseen pikkukaupunkiin. Eikä ihan tavalliseen sellaiseen: kylää piinavat joka ilta vaaralliset olennot. Sarjan taustalta löytyvät suositun Lost-sarjan tuottajat. Aisteja järkyttävä sarja kerännyt kehuja muun muassa kauhun kuninkaalta, Stephen Kingiltä. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: Gåsmamman – Naarasleijona
programme.desc: Sonja on Gerafin käsissä. Vera ei ole enää toivottu missään, tekee kaikkensa kostaakseen Sonjalle ja huomaa Ekin perheen vahvan ketjun heikon lenkin. programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Roger yrittää päästä pakoon sekä Julieta, Kellyä että veljiä ja samalla pelastaa isänsä. Postinkantajan ruumis tulee esiin järvestä. Ove tapaa Dianan. Jo Nesbøn menestysromaanin "Kukkulan kuningas" inspiroima, absurdia komiikkaa sisältävä norjalainen draamatrilleri. programme.title: Marikin hassut seikkailut
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrenin kirjoihin perustuva ruotsalainen lastensarja seitsemänvuotiaasta Marikki-tytöstä, jolla on suuri sydän. 1983

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Kausi päättyy. Saga kysyy, lähteekö Jenny ensi keväänä mukaan Berliiniin. Jenny palauttaa uuden version varjotentistään ja kertoo äidilleen totuuden. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Talouskassa on tyhjä, mutta Morran voi myydä voileipiä verkossa. Tehdessään leipiä rumpujen tahtiin Morran alkaa laulaa. Tobias saa festivaali-idean. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. programme.title: Irralliset
programme.desc: Mathilda ja Johannes pitävät taukoa, ja Mathilda yrittää ymmärtää mitä haluaa. Emil alkaa tapailla Lauraa muttei osaa selittää suhdettaan Yolandaan. Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.desc: Now or never. Sarja alkaa. Tukholman Pride-viikon alkaessa Dilan saapuu tapaamaan Christophin, Ari suunnittelee unohtumatonta viikkoa ja Nina tarvitsee yösijan. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. programme.desc: Perhoshalaus. Annan pahin painajainen toteutuu. Lefan poika löytyy kuolleena. Anna vakuuttaa muille poliiseille, että kyse on alamaailman reviiritaistelusta, ja että Lefan pahin kilpailija on teon takana. Suomi 2022

programme.desc: Kausi päättyy. Roger pakenee Dianan kanssa ja pohtii suunnitelmaa kostaakseen Kellylle ja veljille. Julie lähestyy Rogeria, jota on huijattu. Hamilton löytää Farrin Haigin yllättävästä paikasta ja pääsee viimeinkin Tukholmaa uhkaavien terroristien jäljille, mutta onko kiero suunnitelma ehtinyt edetä jo liian pitkälle? Ruotsalaisessa trillerisarjassa tapaamme Jan Guilloun menestyskirjojen suositun hahmon, nuoren agentin Carl Hamiltonin. Hän palaa Ruotsiin USA:sta monivuotisen Navy SEAL -koulutuksen jälkeen. Samaan aikaan Tukholmaa järkyttää terrori-iskujen sarja. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Gunpowder Milkshake
programme.desc: Sam on 12-vuotias, kun hänen äitinsä, palkkamurhaaja Scarlet, hylkää hänet. Sam kasvaa aikuiseksi saman rikollisorganisaation suojissa, mille Scarlett teki töitä – ja 15 vuotta myöhemmin myös Sam on kovaksikeitetty palkkamurhaaja. Kun Samin keikka menee pieleen ja pieni tyttö tarvitsee suojelua, Samin ainoa keino on ottaa yhteyttä hänen äitiinsä ja tämän tappavan tarkkoihin kollegoihin.

programme.title: Uhka
programme.desc: Ruotsalaisohjaaja Kjell Sundvallin toimintatrilleri kertoo JAS Gripen -hävittäjien parissa salaisessa projektissa työskentelevästä tietokoneohjelmoijasta (Shanti Roney), joka joutuu kiristyksen kohteeksi. Vaarassa on miehen koko perhe.

programme.title: Feed
programme.desc: Kauhuelokuva nuorista, jotka kutsutaan luksusleirintäalueelle erämaahan, missä vaanii jokin paha. Guldbaggenin yleisöpalkinnon voittaja.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: First Home Game

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making The Team

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Drömmar står på spel när uttagningarna för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 års trupp inleds. När grindarna öppnas och 500 tjejer rusar in är den nervösa spänningen påtaglig. Konkurrensen kommer att vara stenhård.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Return of the Vets

programme.desc: "Träningslägrets läskigaste kväll" inleds med en dramatisk händelse när tjejerna lär sig de fruktade hoppspagaten. Det är bara att kämpa sig igenom för tjejerna som ger sig på det berömda och nödvändiga steget.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 503
programme.desc: Den nya receptionisten, Morwenna Newcross, får en dålig start efter att ha kommit sent på sin första arbetsdag. Hennes hyperaktiva beteende får Martin att tro att hon är hög på droger.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Louisas hippiemamma, Eleanor, kommer till byn och tar omedelbart över Martins kök för att göra en ört-tonic, som hon senare ger till barnet för att få honom att sluta gråta.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: PC Penhale blir chockad över att hans ex-fru, Maggie, plötsligt dyker upp och verkar ha glömt att de har separerat och vill nu veta varför han lämnade henne.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Maggie får klartecken från doktorn och bestämmer sig för att återvända till Bude. PC Penhale tvingas vidta desperata metoder för att övertala henne att stanna i Portwenn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 507
programme.desc: Bert Larges restaurang har ekonomiska problem. Han har inte ens råd till mat och dryck för ett välgörenhetsevent för att samla in pengar till Florence Dingles kattfristad.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: TIshell bestämmer sig för att hon inte kan dölja sin kärlek för Martin. Efter att hon druckit en drink, gjord på starka läkemedel, vidtar hon drastiska åtgärder.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 601

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 602

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 603

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
